question.text: The arithmetic mean of numbers a, $\mathrm{b}, \mathrm{c}, \mathrm{d}, \mathrm{e}$ is $\mathrm{M}$. What is the value of $(a-M)+(b-M)+(c-M)+$ $(\mathrm{d}-\mathrm{M})+(\mathrm{e}-\mathrm{M}) ?$

solution.text:
Given $\mathrm{M}=\frac{\mathrm{a}+\mathrm{b}+\mathrm{c}+\mathrm{d}+\mathrm{e}}{5}$

$\Rightarrow a+b+c+d+e=5 M$

$\Rightarrow a+b+c+d+e-5 m=0$

$$

\begin{array}{l}

\Rightarrow(a-M)+(b-M)+(c-M)+(d-M) \\

+(e-M)=0

\end{array}

$$

Hence, required value $=0$
